max.text: u^{3}+\partial_{x}(v)+\partial_{t}(v)+\partial_{t}(v)+u^{2}\cdot \partial_{x}(u\cdot v)+\partial_{y}(p)\cdot u+u+\partial_{t}(p)\cdot u+u\cdot p+\Delta(p)\cdot u+\partial_{t}(p)=0\\v+vv^{3}+u\cdot u+\Delta(v)+\Delta(u)\cdot v+\Delta(v)=0\\\Delta(p)+\Delta(u^{2}+\Delta(p)+\partial_{t}(v)+\Delta(v)+p\cdot v^{2}+u^{2}\cdot p+u^{2}+v^{2}+v\cdot u^{2}+\partial_{t}(p))+v\cdot u+\nabla\cdot(\nabla(p)\Delta(p))^{2}\cdot u+\partial_{t}(u)+\Delta(v)+u\cdot v+x^{2}\cdot v+p^{3}+u+v\cdot v=0

\partial_{x}(v)+\partial_{x}(v)+\partial_{x}(v)+\partial_{xx}(u)+\partial_{t}(v)+\partial_{y}(v)+\partial_{y}(v)+\partial_{x}(v)+\partial_{x}(u)=0\\\partial_{x}(u)+\partial_{t}(v)+\partial_{x}(v)+\partial_{x}(v)\cdot(u\cdot \partial_{x}(p)\cdot u+\partial_{t}(v)+\partial_{x}(u))+\partial_{y}(p^{2}\cdot v^{2}\cdot u+u^{2}\cdot p\cdot \partial_{x}(v)+v^{2}\cdot \partial_{y}(p)\cdot \partial_{x}(v)+\partial_{y}(v)\cdot v+v^{3}+\frac{\sin(u^{2}\cdot \partial_{y}(p)\cdot u+p+p\cdot v+p+u^{2}\cdot \partial_{x}(v)\cdot \partial_{x}(v)+\partial_{x}(u))^{2}+\partial_{y}(u)3\partial_{x}(p^{2}\cdot \partial_{x}(u))+\partial_{y}(u)\cdot \partial_{x}(v^{2}\cdot \partial_{x}(p)\cdot \partial_{y}(u))\cdot \partial_{x}(u)\Delta(u)\cdot u+\partial_{t}(v)+\partial_{x}(u)\Delta(v)\cdot p+\Delta(v)+xx}(u)\cdot \partial_{x}(u)+\partial_{t}+u+\partial_{t}(u)+\partial_{x}(v)+1+u^{2}+v^{2}\cdot \partial_{y}(p)+\partial_{y}(u)\cdot v)+\partial_{x}(u)=0\\(p)+u^{2}\cdot p\cdot v+\partial_{x}(u)\cdot u+(\partial_{y}(v)+\partial_{x}(u)\cdot u)=0

\partial_{t}(u)+\partial_{y}((p\cdot u)+\partial_{x}(u\cdot v)+\partial_{y}(p)+\partial_{t}(u)+\partial_{x}u)+\partial_{x}(u)=0\\\partial_{t}(v)+\nabla\cdot(\nabla(p)\cdot v)+\partial_{y}(u)\cdot p\cdot \partial_{x}(v)\cdot u\cdot \partial_{x}(p)+\partial_{x}(u)\cdot u\cdot \partial_{y}(u)+\partial_{x}(v)+u\cdot \partial_{y}(u)=0\\\partial_{x}(v)\partial_{t}(p)+\partial_{y}(u)+p\cdot v+u^{2}+\partial_{t}(u)+\partial_{y}(u^{2}\cdot \partial_{x}(v)\cdot \partial_{y}(u)(p\cdot u)+v^{2})+\partial_{y}(p^{2}\cdot \partial_{x}(u)+p\cdot \partial_{x}(v)+\partial_{y}(p)\cdot u+\partial_{t}(v)+p^{2}\cdot \partial_{y}(u)+x^{2}\Delta(p)+(\partial_{x}(v))^{2}\cdot(v\cdot \partial_{y}(p)\cdot \partial_{t}(p))+\partial_{y}(v^{2})+p^{2}\cdot \partial_{x}p^{2})+\partial_{x}(v^{2})+\partial_{x}(u)+\partial_{t}(p)=0

\partial_{t}(u)\cdot u+\partial_{t}(v)\cdot u+\Delta(v)\cdot v+\Delta(p)\cdot u+u+v\cdot u+u+v\cdot u^{2}+\partial_{t}(u)+\partial_{y}(v)+v^{2}+\partial_{t}(u)+\Delta(v)\cdot v+\Delta(v)=0\\v+v^{2}\cdot p=0\\\partial_{t}(p)+\Delta(p)+v\cdot (u^{2}+v^{2})^{2}\cdot u+\Delta(u)+u^{3}+v+u+\Delta(v)+v\cdot p+v^{2}\cdot p+\partial_{t}(p)\cdot u+u\cdot \Delta(v)+u\cdot p+(\partial_{x}(u)\cdot v+\Delta(p)\cdot v)+\partial_{y}(\partial_{y}(u)\cdot v^{2}+p\cdot u^{2}p^{2})^{2}+\partial_{t}(p)+\Delta(p)+\partial_{t}(p)+\Delta(u)=0

\partial_{x}(u)\cdot u^{2}+v^{2}\cdot p+\partial_{t}(u)+1+\Delta(v)+\partial_{t}(v)+\partial_{x}(u)+\partial_{t}(u)+\Delta(u)+u^{2}=0\\v+u\cdot \Delta(p)+p+\Delta(p)+v+u=0\\v+u\cdot v^{2}+v+v^{2}\cdot v+u\cdot p+u+p+u^{3}p^{2}+\Delta(u)\cdot p\cdot u+u\cdot p+x^{2}\cdot v+u\cdot \Delta(p)+v+\partial_{t}(p)+p\cdot u^{2}+\partial_{t}(p)+p\cdot u^{2}+u\cdot p+v^{2}+\Delta(p)+p+\Delta(p)+u+p+v\cdot u^{2}+\Delta(p)+u+p+p+v=0
